+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def _request_payload(text: str, mode: str = "redact") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    system = (
+        "You are a moderation assistant. Identify unsafe spans in the input text and either "
+        "flag them with indices or return a redacted version. Respond with JSON only."
+    )
+    user = {
+        "text": text,
+        "mode": mode,
+        "output_schema": {
+            "unsafe_spans": [{"start": 0, "end": 0, "category": "string", "reason": "string"}],
+            "redacted_text": "string",
+            "is_safe": True,
+        },
+    }
+    return {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {"role": "system", "content": system},
+            {"role": "user", "content": str(user)},
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+
+
+def redact_unsafe(text: str, mode: str = "redact", timeout: int = 30) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers=_headers(),
+        json=_request_payload(text, mode),
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        import json
+
+        return json.loads(content)
+    return content
+
+
+def flag_unsafe_spans(text: str, timeout: int = 30) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = redact_unsafe(text, mode="flag", timeout=timeout)
+    return result.get("unsafe_spans", [])
+
+
+def redact_text(text: str, timeout: int = 30) -> str:
+    result = redact_unsafe(text, mode="redact", timeout=timeout)
+    return result.get("redacted_text", text)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def moderate_batch(messages: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for message in messages:
+        response = client.moderations.create(
+            model="omni-moderation-latest",
+            input=message,
+        )
+        result = response.results[0]
+        categories = getattr(result, "categories", {})
+        category_scores = getattr(result, "category_scores", {})
+        results.append(
+            {
+                "message": message,
+                "flagged": bool(result.flagged),
+                "categories": categories.model_dump() if hasattr(categories, "model_dump") else dict(categories),
+                "category_scores": category_scores.model_dump() if hasattr(category_scores, "model_dump") else dict(category_scores),
+            }
+        )
+    return results
+
+
+def handle_batch(messages: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    return moderate_batch(messages)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {"input": text}
+    if model:
+        payload["model"] = model
+    else:
+        payload["model"] = OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    results = data.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        return {
+            "flagged": False,
+            "categories": {},
+            "category_scores": {},
+            "raw": data,
+        }
+
+    result = results[0]
+    return {
+        "flagged": bool(result.get("flagged", False)),
+        "categories": dict(result.get("categories") or {}),
+        "category_scores": dict(result.get("category_scores") or {}),
+        "raw": data,
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import json
+    import sys
+
+    text = sys.stdin.read()
+    output = moderate_text(text)
+    print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** End Patch
